The '''Tinnel IV civil war''' was a [[civil war]] that took place on [[Tinnel IV/Legends|Tinnel IV]]. During it, weapons of mass destruction were unleashed that turned the capital city into a smoking crater known as [[The Abyss (Tinnel IV)|The Abyss]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Into the Abyss}}</ref>
